sql: SELECT f.title, c.company_name, f.published_at FROM fct_posting f JOIN dim_company c ON f.company_key = c.company_key WHERE f.is_open = TRUE AND f.remote_us = TRUE AND f.is_canonical_listing = TRUE ORDER BY f.published_at ASC LIMIT 1
reason: The query filters for open, remote-US, canonical listings and sorts by the publish date in ascending order to find the oldest one.
